DEAD_LETTER_INVALID_STREAM: Dead letter stream must be events or webhooks.
DEAD_LETTER_RETRY_FAILED: The event could not be published again. The dead letter is still there.
DEAD_LETTER_FORBIDDEN: Only a super-admin can manage dead letters.
WOO_PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND: The product no longer exists in WooCommerce (deleted in the store).
ORDER_CHANNEL_UNRESOLVED: This order has no integration to send to. Reconnect the integration it came from.
SALES_ORDER_ORIGIN_NOT_FOUND: Where this order came from is not known.
EXTERNAL_ORDER_ALREADY_IMPORTED: This external order was already imported.
